items.t: Automatic transmission slipping and failure
items.job: Replace transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: A used unit costs less. If a fluid service or solenoid fixes it, the bill is far smaller.

items.t: Car may roll away in Park (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair the shift and park-lock linkage
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer first.

items.t: Transmission servo cover can leak fluid (recall)
items.job: Replace transmission servo cover and seal, refill fluid
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN. Cost rises a lot if low fluid already hurt the transmission.

items.t: Front seat belt buckle stud can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace front seat belt buckle assembly
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer. Price is per seat.

items.t: Broken coil springs that can cut a tire
items.job: Replace both front coil springs
items.note: Price is for both front springs. Add a tire if one was cut. Many cars were covered by recall; check your VIN.

items.t: Adjustable pedals set too close together (recall)
items.job: Modify or replace the adjustable brake pedal assembly
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Brake lights may not work right (recall)
items.job: Replace brake light switch
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
items.job: Replace windshield wiper motor
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Wiper motor can fail from missing grease (recall)
items.job: Replace windshield wiper motor
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Inside door handle spring can unseat (recall)
items.job: Repair or replace inside door handle
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN. Price is per door.

items.t: Electric power steering can shut off (recall)
items.job: Replace electric power steering gear
items.note: Usually free under the recall; some cars only needed a software update. Check your VIN first. Alignment extra.

items.t: Fuel tank seam can leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel tank
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Fuel pump module can crack and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump module
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Fuel pump can lose power and stall the EcoBoost engine (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump or fuel pump control module
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Axle can come apart from the linkshaft (recall)
items.job: Replace front right half shaft
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Axle support bracket can fail (recall)
items.job: Replace intermediate shaft support bracket and bolts
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN. Cost rises if the half shaft was damaged.

items.t: Rear toe link can break (recall, SHO and police)
items.job: Replace rear toe links and align wheels
items.note: Price covers both sides plus an alignment. Usually free under the recall; check your VIN.

items.t: Turbo oil lines can leak (recall)
items.job: Replace turbocharger oil supply line
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN. The rear turbo line takes longer to reach.

items.t: Backup camera picture can be blank or distorted (recall)
items.job: Replace rearview camera
items.note: Usually free under the recall for listed years. Check your VIN first.

items.t: License plate light can short and cause a fire (recall)
items.job: Replace license plate lamp and repair wiring
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Key can come out when not in Park (recall)
items.job: Repair shifter park-lock and key interlock
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Fuel tank bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and retighten fuel tank strap bolts
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Parking brake may not fully apply (recall)
items.job: Adjust or replace parking brake cable
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Power seat support weld may be weak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair or replace front power seat frame
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Internal water pump leaks and can put coolant in the oil
items.job: Replace water pump and timing chain set
items.note: Pump is behind the timing cover. An engine damaged by coolant in the oil costs far more.
